newsitem.title: USA: RJR Nabisco Q3 tobacco, food sales rise.
newsitem.headline: RJR Nabisco Q3 tobacco, food sales rise.

text.p: RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp said on Monday that worldwide tobacco sales for the third quarter rose to $2.11 billion from the year-ago figure of $2.02 billion.
The company reported international tobacco sales of $920 million, compared to $863 million a year ago. Domestic sales were $1.191 billion, compared to $1.156 billion a year ago.
The company said volume was up more than 60 percent in Central Europe. It doubled in Romania and Turkey and returned to double-digit growth in the former Soviet Union, the company said.
Worldwide food sales rose to $2.24 billion in the third quarter from the year-ago figure of of $2.04 billion, the company said.
Domestic food sales were $1.578 billion, compared to year-ago figure of $1.474 billion. International food sales were $660 million compared to year-ago sales of $570 million.
